messages:
Ivy (AE): Aurora Bank wants a quick POC to migrate off CompetitorZ. Requirements: prompt parity for 100 golden prompts, proof of no-data-exfil, and a cost comparison. Can we scope this?
Sam (Solutions): I'll own the compatibility shim. First pass: map fields, translate `stop_sequences` -> `stop`, and normalize streaming frames.
Jo (Presales): They expect <=7% semantic variance on the golden set. Need an eval harness and metric defs (exact match + embedding cosine).
Arjun (SRE): For POC infra, propose a eu-west-2 dev pool, IP allowlist, and SIEM forwarding. I can provision with short-lived creds.
Gita (Security): They require KMS with customer keys and evidence for TLS+encryption at rest. AuditBot: any docs?
AuditBot: SOC2 and ISO certs available under NDA. Customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated/Private. Attach DPA.
Sam (Solutions): Tokenizer differences noted: CompetitorZ splits certain ligatures differently. Add NFC normalization and emoji aliasing before tokenization.
Jo (Presales): I'll build the cost model once we have avg tokens/request and traffic CSV. ETA 3 days after data.
Arjun (SRE): Fallback plan: if semantic_match_rate < 0.88 for 5m, route to CompetitorZ until fixes. Emit trace header `x-fallback-reason`. Need a Console toggle.
Gita (Security): GDPR DSR flows supported in Dedicated/Private; Hosted default retention 30d but adjustable via contract. Also flag: Aurora asked about FIPS — Hosted not FIPS by default.
Ivy (AE): Action items: Sam shim (5d), Jo cost + harness (3d), Arjun infra (2d), Gita security questionnaire (needs architecture input). Present initial results in 9 business days.
Sam (Solutions): I'll push a demo branch and post run commands here when ready.
Jo (Presales): Ping me for the cost template.
Ivy (AE): Thanks team, I'll collect the golden prompt CSV from Aurora and drop into the secure share. :rocket:
